description: The Coil Mirror feed: the open legs and the recent messages of what Coil's own trading engine bought and sold, with the fill price, in the order it happened. A message is sent only after the fill is written. While the feed is not being sent, this returns a feed_down status instead of messages. The status is signed with Ed25519; the public key is served at the path /api/mirror/pubkey.

after_seq.description: Optional: return only messages after this seq (the next_after of your last read). Omit for the most recent messages.

limit.description: Optional: the most messages to return

name: get_mirror_feed
